purpose: Calibrate the summary-quality judge against human labels before Level 2.2 multi-dimensional scoring.

selection.short_long_definition: short is at or below the category median word count; long is above it
selection.replacement: next-ranked eligible case in the same category and length band
selection.source_category_mapping_note: BANKING77 has no exact card_pin label. get_physical_card covers PIN delivery/access; pin_blocked covers blocked/reset PIN. The two labels are not interchangeable.
card_pin_inclusion_criteria: Include only cases whose primary intent is obtaining, locating, receiving, setting up, or viewing a card PIN.
Exclude cases whose primary intent is physical card delivery, blocked/reset PIN, changing PIN, forgotten passcode, or account lock.
Treat source labels as candidate pools; a human reviewer must record the inclusion decision and rationale for each selected card_pin case.

candidate_generation.output_policy: store the raw candidate summary; do not edit it before human review
candidate_generation.failure_policy: replace deterministically and record the failure reason

annotation.reference_summary_policy: human-written from the source input; never copy or paraphrase the candidate as the reference
annotation.audit_selection: first 20 ids ranked by sha256(seed + NUL + 'audit' + NUL + id)
annotation.adjudication: a third annotator or consensus resolves disagreements; only the adjudicated score enters the calibration file

non_goals: Do not include invented, provisional, or model-generated human scores.
Do not tune the judge rubric during annotation.
Do not start Level 2.2 multi-dimensional scoring before the first calibration report is reviewed.
Do not treat the card_pin source-category mapping as exact or validated.
